note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after ten searches for this part, so the rest was read directly from county, city, court, school district and state sites with the kit's fetcher. Websites for the two sitting legislators were found through the links on Branch's nonpartisan guide and then opened on the campaign sites themselves. Checked and not holding the office: Rachel Myers (the State Board of Elections' county clerk list names another person as Hickman County Clerk), Leo Lewis Saylor (not on Grant County's elected officials or fiscal court pages), Megan Bailey (Warren County's fourth district magistrate is another person), Gregory Wayne Phelps (Butler County's fiscal court page names a different Phelps), Amy Stover Smitha (not among the six members on the City of Shelbyville's council page, though a candidate directory calls her an incumbent). Greg Steffen: a search summary said he was running for Independence's council, but the Kenton County Clerk's 2026 general ballot draw lists Greg Steffen under 'Independence Mayor', as our list does; he sits on the council today. Diana Niceley: the City of Erlanger's council page says 'Second Term of Two Years, Four Years of Service' while LINK nky (July 2025) wrote that 2025 was her fifth year on the council, so no start year is recorded. The Revenue Cabinet's PVA directory also prints each PVA's party; that is a directory line, not a ballot, so it is not recorded as past_party. Not reachable or not found: Fleming, Casey, Hickman, Spencer's and Marshall's ky.gov hosts did not resolve or timed out at times; Boyd, Marshall, Kenton, Monroe, Ballard and Cumberland county pages did not name the candidate; Bullitt and Owen school board pages draw their members by script; Madisonville's city site answered 429 and was left alone. Constables and the Ballard County write-in were not found on any official page.
